title: The Herb Salt in the Mortar
youtube_title: The Herb Salt in the Mortar | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A slow finish can be the right finish.
summary: At a ceramic studio table where slip and handles must set, Sable wants to check on a herb salt that needed to rest in the mortar before it is ready. With Nana Ruth nearby, Sable leaves it covered and does a quiet task instead, until it finishes in its own time.
